transcript: parents send this to your college age daughters. So a few weeks ago, I did a reel that went viral and it was about teenage boys, college age boys, ask the girl out. And it went really viral. And a lot of parents reached out and said, Hey, what about the daughters? What are the daughters do? And I have a lot of interest in that because I have two daughters. I have an almost 20 year old and a 22 year old. I've been married for nearly 25 years. So I have a couple of thoughts about that. But the big thing I'd say is it's just coffee. It's just coffee. If a boy asks you out to coffee, it's just coffee. You don't have to make a pressure filled decision of, could I see myself spending the rest of my life with this person? And it doesn't have to be complicated. We've made dating so complicated because of things like the promposal. When I was a kid, if you wanted to go to the prom, you asked somebody to the prom with your mouth, just with the mouth you have. Now you have to have a drone and signs and balloons and confetti. We put so much pressure that a lot of boys are going, I don't want to take that risk. So just coffee, go on a coffee.
